tos.acceptanceText: By accessing or using Nexora, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the platform.
tos.accountText: To use certain features, you must create an account. You agree to:
tos.accountRule1: Provide accurate and complete information during registration
tos.accountRule2: Maintain the security and confidentiality of your password
tos.accountRule3: Be responsible for all activity under your account
tos.accountRule4: Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account
tos.contentText: You retain ownership of content you post on Nexora. By posting content, you grant us a non-exclusive license to display it on the platform. You agree not to post content that:
tos.contentRule1: Is illegal, harmful, threatening, abusive, or harassing
tos.contentRule3: Contains malware, spam, or misleading information
tos.intellectualPropertyText: Nexora and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by Nexora and are protected by international copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws.
tos.terminationText: We may terminate or suspend your account at any time, without prior notice, for conduct that we believe violates these Terms of Service or is harmful to other users, us, or third parties, or for any other reason at our discretion.
tos.disclaimerText: Nexora is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, secure, or error-free.
tos.changesText: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. We will notify users of significant changes via the platform. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.
tos.contactText: If you have questions about these Terms, please contact us at support@Nexora.app.

privacy.introText: At Nexora, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you use our platform.
privacy.collectText: We collect the following types of information:
privacy.collectItem1: Account information: username, email address, and password (encrypted)
privacy.collectItem2: Profile information: avatar, bio, and account visibility preferences
privacy.collectItem3: Content: threads, replies, reactions, and media you upload
privacy.collectItem4: Usage data: login times, features used, and interactions
privacy.useItem1: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
privacy.useItem2: Send you notifications about activity relevant to you
privacy.useItem3: Ensure the security and integrity of the platform
privacy.sharingText: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share information only when required by law, to protect the rights of Nexora, or with your explicit consent.
privacy.securityText: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encrypted passwords, secure HTTPS connections, and rate-limiting to prevent abuse.
privacy.rightsItem1: Access and update your personal information at any time
privacy.rightsItem2: Delete your account and associated data
privacy.rightsItem3: Control the visibility of your profile (public or private)
privacy.retentionText: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we will remove your data within 30 days, except where retention is required by law.
privacy.contactText: For privacy-related inquiries, please contact us at privacy@Nexora.app.

cookies.whatText: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences and improve your experience.
cookies.howText: Nexora uses the following types of cookies and local storage:
cookies.essentialText: Required for the platform to work (authentication tokens, theme choice, language preference)
cookies.preferencesText: Remember your settings such as dark/light theme and display language
cookies.analyticsText: Help us understand how the platform is used so we can improve it (no personally identifiable data is collected)
cookies.thirdPartyText: We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies. Your data stays on Nexora.
cookies.manageText: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may prevent some features from working correctly.
cookies.contactText: If you have questions about our cookie practices, please contact us at support@Nexora.app.

accessibility.commitmentText: Nexora is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for all users, including people with disabilities. We continually improve our platform to provide an inclusive experience.
accessibility.featuresText: Our platform includes the following accessibility features:
accessibility.feature1: Full keyboard navigation support throughout the application
accessibility.feature2: ARIA labels on interactive elements for screen reader compatibility
accessibility.feature3: High-contrast color themes and dark/light mode support
accessibility.feature4: Right-to-left (RTL) language support for Arabic and other RTL languages
accessibility.feature5: Focus management and visible focus indicators
accessibility.standardsText: We aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA. We regularly test our platform with assistive technologies.
accessibility.feedbackText: We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of Nexora. If you encounter any accessibility barriers, please let us know so we can address them promptly.
accessibility.contactText: For accessibility concerns or suggestions, please contact us at accessibility@Nexora.app.
